text: One local story tells that a farmer from Þverárkot found the silver of Egil one day when he was on his way to Mosfell. When he came to the Kýrgil (Cow Ravine), he decided to go up the ravine to answer natures call. There he found the silver of Egil. He hid it well but after a few years people started to notice that he had gotten quite rich. The story claims that the farmer exchanged the silver for cash with Jón Ólafsson the Rich from Borgarfjörður in western Iceland.
